instances.claim: This tells me that the set is a year-indexed run of copper cents with several year-shaped gaps in it, of which 1943 is the only interesting one.
instances.why: "Only one of the years it misses" is a partitive over a plurality of missed years, but the draft never introduces the set as organised by date at all — line 5 bounds it as ten thousand copper cents and line 20 gives it a single end point at 1982, neither of which establishes year-by-year membership or any gap, let alone more than one.

instances.claim: This tells me that the cents, once released, were held by a body of collectors who could be polled.
instances.why: "The collectors" is a definite phrase for a group the draft has not introduced by line 13; the only collecting named so far is Chang's own (line 6), and the release that would create owners does not arrive until line 19, so the voting that produces the names rests on a population the piece never puts in.
